name: calc_integral_arctan_zero_one
statement: : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.arctan x = Real.pi / 4 - Real.log 2 / 2
closed: ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.arctan x = Real.pi / 4 - Real.log 2 / 2
informal: ∫₀¹ arctan x dx = π/4 − (log 2)/2 — antiderivative x arctan x − log(1+x²)/2; FTC, arctan 1 = π/4.
type: ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..1, Real.arctan x = Real.pi / 4 - Real.log 2 / 2
